label: Published homepage
note: The public homepage trailer before this editing series began.

label: 00 · Start of the 24-hour run
note: The homepage cut when the 24-hour series began. The tank opens at full volume and a separate night battle follows the harbour strike.

label: 01 · Squad to harbour
note: Starts with a handful of soldiers and ends on the jet’s harbour strike. The crew and mortar bursts read together. The opening feels quiet and a high chirp cuts across the landing.

label: 02 · Give the order
note: One order appears on the road and five selected soldiers move. The harbour landing loses the sharp bird call. The gap after the mortar and the last water impacts still need musical shape.

label: 03 · Harbour crescendo
note: Same pictures as 02. The game’s battle music carries the landing, then the victory drums resolve with the water impacts. The score now fills the space around the boats; the last chord still ends quickly.

label: 04 · From road to harbour
note: First 24-second edition, rebuilt after the main merge. A close trench cut reveals its scale, a helicopter lifts a vehicle, and the landing boats, patrol ship and jet share the mountain coast. On muted playback the helicopter rotor is almost edge-on and the lead boat appears to sit high.

label: 05 · From the order to the waterline
note: The road order cuts to the same squad at shoulder height. A higher camera shows the cargo lift clear. From the middle launch, two wakes curve toward the harbour. The open boats still look empty.

label: 06 · A squad reaches shore
note: A tank crosses the foreground at 2.4 s. Follow the launches at water level, then see the squad leave the beaching boat at 15.1 s. The passing patrol ship connects the two shots. The bows stay visible through the shallows.

label: 07 · Dawn crossing and falling spray
note: Track the squad toward town at 1.33 s. At 20.73 s the jet gives way to four rising water impacts that fall back around the ship. The landing launches still look unoccupied in close-up.

label: 08 · The patrol pass
note: The shore shot leads into the patrol ship’s bow view as a second boat passes alongside. The menu title appears over the harbour at 22.4 s, above phone controls and captions. The helicopter rotor is still hard to see against the field.

label: 09 · Aboard the lift and landing
note: The sunlit helicopter carries the Humvee into the cargo-door shot on the same lift. The starboard camera follows a launch through its turn, with foam spreading behind both motors. The mortar pit at 7.5 s still feels static.

label: 10 · Over the trench wall
note: Riflemen cross the wall beside a tracked vehicle at 5.17 s. A moving camera reveals the mortar crew and tube before the overhead bursts. At 9.97 s the rotor reads against the sky. The final harbour shot still holds the boat far from the viewer.

label: 11 · From the road to the waterline
note: The opening order cuts to riflemen approaching the lens. At 15.10 s the squad runs past the launch at shoulder height while the patrol ship crosses behind. At 20.73 s the jet cuts to the stern quarter and the spray rises against the mountain. The open launches still need visible crews.

label: 12 · Behind the helm
note: At 12.70 s the new F9 Helm view rides behind the seated driver. Watch the second crew turn for shore, then follow the landing party at 15.10 s. The helicopter lift still takes place over an open field.

label: 13 · Over the bridge
note: 9.97–12.70 s. A bridge-deck flyover cuts to the cargo door on the next frame of the same Sky Hook flight. Four shaded straps meet the tracked vehicle as the bridge passes beneath it.

label: 14 · Inside the sandbags
note: 7.07–8.17 s. Meet the textured specialist as he clears the sandbags and drops to one knee before the overhead burst. The suspended Nyx stays level over the riverbank at 9.97–12.70 s.

label: 15 · From the pad to the harbour
note: The order cuts to the same five soldiers as the Mohawk lifts behind them. Its cargo-door view returns over the bridge. The playable Stern quarter camera holds the boat under the rising spray at 20.73 seconds.

label: 16 · Over the port rail
note: Establish the patrol ship from the bow, then cut aboard its bridge roof as the second craft passes. Its wake builds along the hull and the water stays visible through the blast.

label: 17 · Armour through the village
note: Two Abrams emerge from the mountain pass and cross the village road. At 7.07 seconds the mortar stays on the left as a specialist vaults the sandbags.

label: 18 · Behind the column
note: Follow the second Abrams along the village road, then cut to the first hull from the verge. The tread dust spreads close to the track marks.

label: 19 · Follow the squad leader
note: The opening move order cuts to the same squad leader at eye level. At 9.97 s the bridge rail frames the entire helicopter and its suspended vehicle.

label: 20 · The field medic
note: The medic crossing beside the squad leader now wears the animated uniform. Watch the marked sleeve and aid pack as he moves across the clearing.

label: 21 · Over the landing force
note: The jet overtakes the camera above the coast. Watch the landing boats pass beneath its wing before the view drops back to the patrol ship.

label: 22 · From pit to field
note: The crew fires from the sandbag pit. Follow the same round to the field beyond the wreck, where the soil breaks into uneven clods.

label: 23 · Eyes on the load
note: The cargo-door camera follows the Nyx as it swings over the bridge. The cable, four straps and the shadow stay visible through the crossing.

label: 24 · Give the order
note: See the squad and its helicopter together. The move ring appears on open ground, then the next cut takes you to eye level alongside the running soldiers.

label: 25 · Over the launches
note: The Black Wasp comes off the cliff, draws level above the launches, then passes the camera. Watch the falling stores carry across the cut to the boat.

label: 26 · The truck on the quay
note: The gunner works the fixed mortar at 9.93 seconds. Follow the jet to an intact harbour truck, then watch the ground strike roll it into a burning wreck.

label: 27 · From the harbour to the trench line
note: Two patrol boats close on the ship. Follow the jet to the quay, then the two infantry fighting vehicles and riflemen to the occupied trenches. The 155 mm barrage cuts to the live menu map.

label: 28 · The trench under artillery
note: The jet and the intact harbour truck share a frame. Two infantry fighting vehicles advance with rifle squads, then the reverse looks out from the occupied trench. A rising wide shot follows the actual 155 mm shell impacts across the line before the moving menu and free-platform invitation.

label: 29 · Hear the jet cross the harbour
note: Hear the engine beside the jet, then from the ground as it recedes and falling air builds into the hit. The opening shows the Nyx lifting. The trench camera keeps both rifle squads in view. The menu survey and larger platform line close the film.

label: 30 · Under the wing
note: The opening follows a real sling pickup order. At the coast, see the quay from behind the jet, then hear and see each release from below the wing. The ground view carries the falling air into impact.
